rules.title: Allowable Rent Increase for March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027
rules.requirement: Landlords may increase rent by a maximum of 1.6% for the period March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027.

rules.title: Security Deposit Interest Rate for March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027
rules.requirement: Landlords must pay interest on security deposits held for tenants at the rate of 4.2% per annum for the period March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027.
rules.citation: SF Rent Board Current Rates, Section 572

rules.coverage_conditions: San Francisco rental units with security deposits held by landlord during period March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027

rule.title: Relocation Payments for Owner/Relative Move-in, Demolition, Capital Improvement, or Substantial Rehabilitation Evictions
rule.requirement: Landlords must provide relocation payments to tenants evicted for owner/relative move-in, demolition/permanent removal from housing use, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation. For period March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027: $8,245.00 per tenant (maximum $24,733.00 per unit), plus $5,497.00 additional for each elderly (60+ years), disabled tenant, or household with minor children.
rule.citation: SF Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C, SF Rent Board Current Rates Section 579

rule.title: Relocation Payments for Ellis Act Evictions
rule.requirement: Landlords must provide relocation payments to tenants evicted under the Ellis Act. For period March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027: $11,110.05 per tenant (maximum $33,330.13 per unit), plus $7,443.90 additional for each elderly (62+ years) or disabled tenant.

rule.title: Relocation Payments for Temporary Displacement Less Than 20 Days
rule.requirement: Landlords must provide relocation payments to tenants temporarily displaced for less than 20 days at $446.00 per day plus actual moving expenses for period March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027.
rule.citation: SF Rent Ordinance, SF Rent Board Current Rates, California Civil Code Section 1947.9
